articles.title: Why Darian Mensah Was Snubbed for Johnny Unitas Golden Arm Award After Arch, Finalists Revealed
articles.summary: Miami quarterback Darian Mensah wasn't included among the finalists for the 2026 Johnny Unitas Golden Arm Award, which is presented to the nation's top upperclassman passer.
articles.body:
Miami quarterback Darian Mensah wasn't included among the finalists for the 2026 Johnny Unitas Golden Arm Award, which is presented to the nation's top upperclassman passer.

Texas' Arch Manning, Notre Dame's CJ Carr, Utah's Devon Dampier, Oklahoma State's Drew Mestemaker and Georgia's Gunner Stockton were announced as the finalists for the annual honor on Friday.

Biggest 5-Star Recruiting Busts of Past Decade 👎

Mensah has spearheaded a Hurricanes offense that ranks No. 1 in the country with an average of 44.1 points per game this season, but he wasn't included as a candidate.

Mensah's omission was due to the fact that he wasn't eligible for the Unitas Award, as quarterbacks aren't permitted to compete for more than two schools throughout their college career in order to qualify.

He previously suited up for Tulane and Duke before transferring to Miami.

Still, Mensah has put together a stellar 2026 campaign and is on track to be considered for Heisman Trophy honors.

In 10 games, he's completed 76.3 percent of his throws for 3,076 yards and 29 touchdowns compared to a mere two interceptions. He's also rushed for 144 yards and two scores.

Mensah has led Miami to an impressive 9-1 record, sitting at No. 7 in the latest College Football Playoff rankings.

articles.title: El bonito gesto de España con Enzo Alves tras golear a China
articles.standfirst: La selección Sub-18 posó con la camiseta del hijo de Marcelo, que se concentró con el grupo en Las Rozas pero fue desconvocado por lesión a las puertas del Mundial
articles.summary: La selección Sub-18 posó con la camiseta del hijo de Marcelo, que se concentró con el grupo en Las Rozas pero fue desconvocado por lesión a las puertas del Mundial
articles.body: España celebró su estreno mundialista con un detalle hacia el gran ausente. Tras golear 5-0 a China en su debut en el Mundial Sub-17 de Catar, los jugadores de David Cubillo posaron sobre el césped con la camiseta de Enzo Alves, el delantero que se quedó fuera de la cita a última hora por una lesión. Un guiño de vestuario para que el hijo de Marcelo, pese a la distancia, sintiera suya también la victoria. El gesto tiene su intrahistoria. Enzo llegó a concentrarse con el grupo en Las Rozas, donde pasó dos días realizándose pruebas médicas. El diagnóstico, sin embargo, no dejó margen. Una lesión muscular en el psoas, sufrida justo antes de la convocatoria, lo apartó del Mundial. Tanto el Real Madrid como los servicios médicos de la selección entendieron que los plazos de recuperación se alargaban demasiado para un torneo que exige estar al cien por cien. El propio jugador quiso estar presente pese a la distancia. Durante el partido, Enzo compartió una imagen siguiendo el encuentro desde el ordenador, acompañada de un mensaje de aliento: “Vamos mis chavales”. El delantero vivió como uno más la goleada de unos compañeros con los que había compartido concentración apenas unos días antes de caer de la lista. Su ausencia dolió también en el banquillo. “Estuvo dos días con nosotros en Las Rozas, porque le tuvimos que hacer pruebas”, explicó Cubillo en la previa. “Está fastidiado, porque él aquí es importante y ha venido siempre, pero en estas dos últimas convocatorias no ha podido por lesión. Son cosas que ellos aceptan, porque va a ser su vida”. Palabras que retrataban el cariño de un grupo que no pensaba olvidarse de él.

articles.title: Mourinho y Pedro León, un reencuentro con mucho morbo en el palco del Di Stéfano
articles.standfirst: El entrenador del Real Madrid y el actual presidente del Real Murcia protagonizaron momentos muy tensos en la primera etapa del técnico portugués en el equipo blanco
articles.summary: El entrenador del Real Madrid y el actual presidente del Real Murcia protagonizaron momentos muy tensos en la primera etapa del técnico portugués en el equipo blanco
articles.body: El encuentro entre el Real Madrid Castilla y el Real Murcia del grupo 2 de Primera RFEF ha dejado una imagen con mucho morbo. José Mourinho, entrenador del Real Madrid, y Pedro León, presidente del equipo murciano, se han reencontrado en el palco del Estadio Alfredo Di Stéfano muchos años después de protagonizar uno de los desencuentros más recordados entre un jugador y el técnico luso durante su primera etapa en el equipo blanco. Para encontrar el origen hay que remontarse a la campaña 2010-11, la primera de Pedro León en el Real Madrid, equipo al que llegó procedente del Getafe. El punto de ruptura público entre entrenador y jugador llegó en el mes de septiembre de ese 2010, al poco de comenzar la temporada. Durante una rueda de prensa, a Mourinho le preguntaron con insistencia por qué no había convocado al jugador para un partido de Champions, a lo que el técnico finalmente contestó de manera contundente. "Habláis de Pedro como Zidane, Di Stéfano o Maradona y es un buen jugador que hace dos días jugaba en el Getafe", respondió. Y a partir de ahí se deterioró la relación entre ambos. Pedro León se refirió hace unos meses, en julio de este año, a aquellas palabras de Mourinho. "La primera vez que tengo ese tipo de problemas con él fue cuando la rueda de prensa. Yo antes no había tenido ningún problema", explicó en una entrevista en el podcast de YouTube 'El After de Post United' y continuó: "Yo no sé muy bien por dónde vino y después hubo reuniones y momentos tensos. En el mercado de enero llegó una oferta del Chelsea y todos estábamos de acuerdo en salir, pero él no me dejó. Y luego no jugué nada, solo unos minutos en Mestalla a final de temporada". Ahora, más de una década después de todo aquello, ambos se han vuelto a encontrar en el palco del Estadio Alfredo Di Stéfano para presenciar ese Real Madrid Castilla-Real Murcia.

articles.title: Los condicionantes de los próximos sorteos de Copa del Rey y de la Copa de la Reina
articles.standfirst: La Ciudad del Fútbol de Las Rozas será el escenario en el que se definirán los próximos cruces de ambas competiciones los días 23 y 26 de noviembre
articles.summary: La Ciudad del Fútbol de Las Rozas será el escenario en el que se definirán los próximos cruces de ambas competiciones los días 23 y 26 de noviembre
articles.body: La Ciudad del Fútbol de Las Rozas acogerá durante la última semana de noviembre dos nuevos sorteos: el de la segunda eliminatoria de la Copa del Rey Mapfre y el de los octavos de final de la Copa de la Reina Iberdrola. El primero de ellos tendrá lugar el lunes 23, a las 12:30 horas, y definirá 28 nuevas eliminatorias de la Copa del Rey, cuyos emparejamientos estarán condicionados por dos criterios establecidos en las bases de competición: el enfrentamiento, siempre que sea posible, entre equipos de inferior y superior categoría, y la proximidad geográfica, que en esta ronda reducirá de cuatro a dos los grupos territoriales, con una distribución de norte y sur que incluye a 36 y 20 clubes, respectivamente. Los clubes se distribuirán en cinco copas, correspondientes a Primera División (15), Segunda División (18), Primera Federación (14), Segunda Federación (8) y Copa Federación (1). En cuanto a la localía, los encuentros se disputarán en el campo del equipo de inferior categoría; en caso de enfrentarse dos conjuntos de la misma división, ejercerá como local aquel cuya bola sea extraída en primer lugar. CONFIGURACIÓN DE ENFRENTAMIENTOS SEGÚN CONDICIONANTES: Los cuatro participantes en la Supercopa de España masculina no entrarán hasta dieciseisavos de final: FC Barcelona, Real Madrid CF, Real Sociedad y Atlético de Madrid. Por su parte, la Copa de la Reina celebrará el sorteo de octavos de final el jueves 26 de noviembre, a las 16:30 horas, una vez completada la tercera ronda con la disputa del encuentro aplazado entre el CD Sporting Club y el FC Levante LP Badalona, previsto para el miércoles 25 a las 19:00 horas. En esta fase entrarán en competición los ocho primeros clasificados de la temporada 2025/26: FC Barcelona, Real Madrid CF, Real Sociedad, Costa Adeje Tenerife, Atlético de Madrid, Granada CF, Athletic Club y Sevilla FC, que se unirán a los ocho equipos procedentes de la ronda anterior. El sorteo comenzará con la extracción de las bolas de los dos conjuntos de Segunda Federación Iberdrola que ya han conseguido su clasificación, a los que podría sumarse un tercero en función del resultado del encuentro pendiente entre el CD Sporting Club y el FC Levante LP Badalona. Estos equipos quedarán emparejados con rivales de Liga F, mientras que el resto de los cruces se determinará mediante un sorteo sin condicionantes. Los partidos se disputarán en el campo del equipo de inferior categoría y, si ambos pertenecen a la misma división, en el de aquel cuya bola salga primero .

articles.title: Tom Brady reportedly purchases ownership stake in Chelsea after sudden exit from Birmingham City
articles.summary: Birmingham City announced earlier this month that Brady had left the club's ownership circle three years after purchasing a 3.3% stake.
articles.body:
Tom Brady is leveling up his Premier League ownership: The NFL legend has reportedly purchased shares in Chelsea Football Club, per multiple reports.

The Guardian reported Friday that Brady was in talks to buy shares. ESPN later reported that the purchase had been completed.

The move came just a few weeks after Brady suddenly exited the ownership group of Birmingham City , a club in the second-tier Championship League. Brady became a minority owner of the team in 2023, holding a 3.3% stake while serving as the chairman of Birmingham City's advisory board.

Birmingham City announced Brady's exit on Nov. 9, expressing "sincere gratitude" to Brady for his time with the club but providing no details on his departure.

Brady was present at Chelsea's decisive Club World Cup victory over Paris Saint-Germain in 2025 as a guest of the Premier League club, via The Guardian, and was spotted celebrating with Chelsea players after the win.

Chelsea's ownership has seen significant turnover with the recent exit of Los Angeles Dodgers owner Mark Walter: In September, Walter and co-owner Todd Boehly sold off their shares in Chelsea, just a month after Walter's surprise sale of the Los Angeles Lakers.

Walter's and Boehly's shares were sold to majority owner Clearlake Capital, which now has full control of the club. Walter is currently the subject of a federal investigation , which likely contributed to the timing of his sales.

Brady is also a minority owner of the Las Vegas Aces and the Las Vegas Raiders.

articles.title: Cink Confirms PGA Tour Champions Wants Tiger Woods In 2027
articles.summary: Stewart Cink reveals the senior tour welcomes Tiger Woods for 2027, while Woods prepares for his return at the Hero World Challenge in two weeks.
articles.body:
Stewart Cink has confirmed that the PGA Tour Champions would welcome Tiger Woods if the 15-time major champion chooses to compete on the senior circuit in 2027. The 2009 Open champion made the comments during an interview on SiriusXM PGA TOUR Radio, addressing the speculation surrounding Woods' future schedule. Cink stated that Woods is a primary candidate for the senior tour's growth, noting that his presence would benefit the tour and the player alike. Since July 2024, when The Open Championship took place, Woods has not competed in any tournament. He faces a busy few weeks ahead, with a return to action scheduled for the Hero World Challenge in the Bahamas in just two weeks.

The conversation about Woods joining the senior tour comes as he navigates significant personal and physical challenges. HITC reports that Woods has faced two severe car crashes and has repeatedly entered and left rehabilitation to handle a painkiller addiction. Despite these hurdles, Cink believes Woods remains a fighter who wants to compete. "We would love for Tiger to come play, and he's one of the guys I have in mind when I constantly say, like, guys are gonna like it out there," Cink explained. He added that while he does not know Woods' specific plans, he hopes Woods plays because it would be great for the tour. While Woods aims for major tournaments like The Masters, The Open Championship, and The Genesis Invitational in 2027, competing in senior events might offer needed practice.

Woods' long-time agent Mark Steinberg has highlighted the difficulty of managing a player of Woods' stature. Bob Philion highlighted Steinberg's point during the Real Deal podcast that elite athletes need candid discussions. He observed that top-tier athletes frequently find themselves surrounded by individuals who merely say what those athletes wish to hear. Steinberg told GolfMagic , "You got to tell that person what they need to hear, not what they want to hear." He described this dynamic as uncomfortable but essential for success. "There's a lot of people when you get to stardom level that have a lot of people around them that tell them what they want to hear," Steinberg continued. "And that's not a good recipe."

Steinberg has represented Woods since 1998 and was involved in 14 of his major victories. The agent's approach focuses on difficult truths rather than flattery, a strategy that has defined his tenure with Woods and other stars like Annika Sorenstam and Michelle Wie. This honest communication style is crucial as Woods prepares to return to competitive golf after a long hiatus. The agent's comments suggest that Woods' team is carefully evaluating his readiness and the types of events that will best serve his recovery and competitive goals.

The discussion about Woods' future also touches on broader tensions within professional golf regarding image rights and player compensation. Phil Mickelson previously criticized the PGA Tour for what he called "obnoxious greed" regarding media rights. Mickelson claimed the Tour forced him to pay $1 million for his own media rights during "The Match" events. "That type of greed is, to me, beyond obnoxious," Mickelson said in comments reported by HITC. These comments sparked a debate among players, with Brooks Koepka responding on Instagram. Koepka wrote, "Don't know if I'd be using the word greedy if I'm Phil." While these disputes highlight the friction between players and the tour, Cink's comments focus purely on the competitive aspect of Woods returning to the game.

Cink emphasized that Woods is a golfer at heart who simply wants to compete. The sentiment from the senior tour is one of openness rather than restriction. If Woods decides to play PGA Tour Champions events to build his game, the reception will be enthusiastic. The focus remains on Woods' health and his ability to perform at the highest level again.

articles.title: El Lega remonta a un Andorra en inferioridad de la mano de un gran Morata
articles.standfirst: Álvaro asistió a Álex Millán en el 1-1 y marcó el 1-2, mientras los del Principado pagaron la temprana expulsión de Hugo Solozábal
articles.summary: Álvaro asistió a Álex Millán en el 1-1 y marcó el 1-2, mientras los del Principado pagaron la temprana expulsión de Hugo Solozábal
articles.body: El Leganés aprovechó la inferioridad numérica durante más de una hora del Andorra, por la expulsión de Hugo Solozabal, para remontar y llevarse la victoria en el Encamp de la mano de un gran Álvaro Morata, que asistió en el primer gol y marcó el segundo, antes de marcharse lesionado. Los pepineros, que fallaron un penalti por medio de Dani Rodríguez, enlazan su segunda victoria seguida y vuelven a ganar fuera tras haber sumado un solo punto en sus cinco anteriores salidas, mientras los del Principado, que se adelantaron por medio de Carrique pero sufren una expulsión por tercer jornada seguida, suman su cuarta derrota en las últimas cinco jornadas disputadas. Sin sorpresa respecto al guion que se podía esperar, el partido comenzó con posesión local, aunque fueron los visitantes quienes tuvieron la primera, muy clara, por medio de Álex Sancris que, tras un fallo de Doménech en la cesión de cabeza a su portero, encaró a Pau López pero no centró bien a Morata y Juan Sebastián llegó a tiempo de evitar el gol. El plan de partido de ambos conjuntos cambió totalmente tras un pisotón de Hugo Solozábal a Atienza que, tras la revisión del VAR, acabó en roja directa para el jugador local. Se había llegado justo al cuarto de hora. Aun así, los de Manso siguieron dominaron y, tras dos ocasiones muy claras, cuando Luca Zidane tuvo que responder con un paradón al cabezazo de Spatz, mientras un zurdazo cruzado de Hugo López se marchó fuera por poco, acabaron abriendo la lata a la media hora. Carrique marcó con una volea cruzada tras un gran centro de Sidibe desde la izquierda. Sin embargo, la alegría duró poco, ya que seis minutos después Álex Millán empataba llegando desde atrás al empalmar la gran dejada de Morata... quien culminaba la remontada antes del descanso al lanzarse al suelo y rematar el centro de Sancris. En los casi nueve minutos de añadido de este primer tiempo, Pau López le detuvo a Dani Rodríguez el penalti señalado por agarrón de Doménech a Unax del Cura... mientras Lautaro de Léon mandó por encima del larguero una falta directa desde la frontal. En la reanudación el Lega rondó el tercero, pero el cabezazo de Álex Millán a centro de Jorge Martínez lo despejó Pau López, mientras que solicitó otro penalti al dar un centro de Marvel en el brazo de Bomba, pero tras revisarlo en el monitor el andaluz José Luis Guzmán decidió que no lo había. Tras un triple cambio de Manso el Andorra ganó en energía y Carrique rondó el empate, pero de nuevo Luca Zidane realizó otra gran parada y se lo negó. Morata se tuvo que marchar lesionado y los cambios que acabaron resultaron decisivos fueron los de Carrión, ya que la sentencia llegó con un gol de Naim tras asistencia de Gharbi, mientras que en el añadido Luca Zidane se volvió a lucir a mano cambiada ante el disparo cruzado y con efecto de Enes Sali.

articles.title: How much Tennessee athletics has already distributed in revenue sharing for 2027
articles.summary: The Tennessee Athletics Foundation held its 2026 board of directors meeting on Nov. 20, offering some insight into UT's revenue sharing with athletes.
articles.body:
Tennessee athletics has already distributed $6.1 million to student-athletes from its approximately $21.6 million revenue sharing budget for the fiscal year 2027, with another $5.9 million earmarked for distribution.

These numbers were provided during the UT Athletics Foundation's 2026 board of directors meeting on Nov. 20. The board is chaired by UT Chancellor Donde Plowman.

The foundation was established as a 501(c)(3) non-profit in June 2024 to improve business operations efficiency within the athletic department. It could also mobilize into a fund to pay salaries to athletes if the NCAA allows it in the future.

Danny White, Tennessee AD for Vols, including football, basketball, baseball, softball

The foundation currently facilitates payments to athletes through revenue sharing, which became possible July 2025 after the approval of the House v. NCAA settlement. Tennessee , like many power conference schools, is allotting the maximum amount of revenue sharing under the current cap. Such payments are separate from name, image and likeness deals through third parties.

The UT Athletics Foundation's fiscal year 2027 budget includes $21,583,913 in revenue sharing.

The foundation partnered in 2025 with Ramp, a financial technology company that utilizes AI tools, to help with its finances. One example given of its value was an unnamed men's basketball transfer recruit being able to receive payment the same day they signed with Tennessee.

Tennessee has also built out its own in-house football analytics systems to help with player evaluation and valuation.

The topic of outside private investment was briefly addressed at the meeting. It was said that such opportunities have been coming up "on a weekly basis" but "nothing has made sense so far."

What Danny White said at UT Athletics Foundation meeting

Athletics director Danny White didn't dive into many details during the public portion of the meeting, although he did mention that UT athletics expects to pass $375 million in revenue this fiscal year.

White gave an overview of each active Tennessee program to the board, starting with the football team. He noted its 8-2 record and No. 9 ranking in the College Football Playoff poll ahead of the home game against LSU on Nov. 21.

"In a public meeting, I'll say I think we should be ranked higher than that and I have confidence that the committee is going to rectify that," White said.

He also commented on the late-season coaching change for Tennessee women's soccer, which earned a surprise bid to the NCAA Tournament despite not making the SEC Tournament. Tennessee fired coach Joe Kirt on Nov. 2, and UT announced 15 days later the hiring of Purdue coach Richard Moodie , who signed a five-year contract worth $1.5 million . Moodie will take over after the season.

"We made a coaching change, which is odd while we're still playing soccer, but with the new calendar that we're dealing with and the transfer portal – it's been very public around football with the challenges around the calendar. Same thing applies to every fall sport we have," White said. "And I think we've managed it professionally and respectfully to student athletes and staff."

articles.title: How much Tennessee athletics has already distributed in revenue sharing for 2027
articles.summary: The Tennessee Athletics Foundation held its 2026 board of directors meeting on Nov. 20, offering some insight into UT's revenue sharing with athletes.
articles.body:
Tennessee athletics has already distributed $6.1 million to student-athletes from its approximately $21.6 million revenue sharing budget for the fiscal year 2027, with another $5.9 million earmarked for distribution.

These numbers were provided during the UT Athletics Foundation's 2026 board of directors meeting on Nov. 20. The board is chaired by UT Chancellor Donde Plowman.

The foundation was established as a 501(c)(3) non-profit in June 2024 to improve business operations efficiency within the athletic department. It could also mobilize into a fund to pay salaries to athletes if the NCAA allows it in the future.

The foundation currently facilitates payments to athletes through revenue sharing, which became possible July 2025 after the approval of the House v. NCAA settlement. Tennessee , like many power conference schools, is allotting the maximum amount of revenue sharing under the current cap. Such payments are separate from name, image and likeness deals through third parties.

The UT Athletics Foundation's fiscal year 2027 budget includes $21,583,913 in revenue sharing.

The foundation partnered in 2025 with Ramp, a financial technology company that utilizes AI tools, to help with its finances. One example given of its value was an unnamed men's basketball transfer recruit being able to receive payment the same day they signed with Tennessee.

Tennessee has also built out its own in-house football analytics systems to help with player evaluation and valuation.

The topic of outside private investment was briefly addressed at the meeting. It was said that such opportunities have been coming up "on a weekly basis" but "nothing has made sense so far."

What Danny White said at UT Athletics Foundation meeting

Athletics director Danny White didn't dive into many details during the public portion of the meeting, although he did mention that UT athletics expects to pass $375 million in revenue this fiscal year.

White gave an overview of each active Tennessee program to the board, starting with the football team. He noted its 8-2 record and No. 9 ranking in the College Football Playoff poll ahead of the home game against LSU on Nov. 21.

"In a public meeting, I'll say I think we should be ranked higher than that and I have confidence that the committee is going to rectify that," White said.

He also commented on the late-season coaching change for Tennessee women's soccer, which earned a surprise bid to the NCAA Tournament despite not making the SEC Tournament. Tennessee fired coach Joe Kirt on Nov. 2, and UT announced 15 days later the hiring of Purdue coach Richard Moodie , who signed a five-year contract worth $1.5 million . Moodie will take over after the season.

"We made a coaching change, which is odd while we're still playing soccer, but with the new calendar that we're dealing with and the transfer portal – it's been very public around football with the challenges around the calendar. Same thing applies to every fall sport we have," White said. "And I think we've managed it professionally and respectfully to student athletes and staff."

articles.title: Mauricio Pochettino confirms Bruno Fernandes decision ahead of Liverpool test
articles.summary: Bruno Fernandes to Remain Manchester United Captain Under Mauricio PochettinoMauricio Pochettino has made his first significant call at Manchester United and...
articles.body:
Bruno Fernandes to Remain Manchester United Captain Under Mauricio Pochettino

Mauricio Pochettino has made his first significant call at Manchester United and there is no ambiguity around it. Bruno Fernandes remains club captain.

That was the headline from Pochettino's first media appearance after taking charge at Old Trafford, where he inherits a side in the Premier League relegation zone and a dressing room that has looked unstable for weeks. His first assignment is brutal enough, an away trip to Liverpool, and he arrives with one obvious fire to contain, the future and authority of Fernandes.

The Portugal international has reportedly turned down two contract offers this season. His current deal expires at the end of the campaign, which means from January he can agree a pre-contract with an overseas club and walk away for nothing. For a player of his profile, that is a major issue.

There has also been noise around his behaviour. Fernandes publicly questioned his former manager's tactics after the 4-1 Champions League defeat to Como. He was then dropped for the 3-0 loss at home to Bournemouth, before returning for the 2-0 defeat at Chelsea after talks with Michael Carrick.

Pochettino did what a new manager often has to do, remove uncertainty, at least publicly. "I think the commitment of all the players is amazing from day one," he said. "Bruno is our captain and he's a very important player, but all the player must feel they are important.

"We chatted yesterday and spent three hours chatting in my office with all the players. I missed some injured players, but in the next few days, I will talk to everyone."

Manchester United Contract Issue Still Open

This does not settle the contract stand-off. Pochettino admitted there "would be time" to address Fernandes' long-term future and avoided making any stronger guarantee beyond the armband.

That is sensible. Manchester United need points, order and clarity. Pochettino has started with the easiest message to send. The harder part comes next, winning matches and convincing Fernandes that his future still belongs at Old Trafford.

articles.title: Mikel Arteta provides injury update on Bukayo Saka while defender set for long-awaited return
articles.summary: Arsenal manager Mikel Arteta has confirmed that Bukayo Saka and Martín Zubimendi will both miss Saturday's Premier League match at Newcastle United, while a...
articles.body:
Mikel Arteta has confirmed that both Bukayo Saka and Martín Zubimendi will miss Arsenal's Premier League match against Newcastle United.

The Gunners travel to St James' Park on Saturday, with Arteta's side sitting five points clear at the top of the table. As they look to extend their impressive run of five consecutive league victories to six, they will be forced to do so without two of their most influential players.

Saka continues to be sidelined with the injury he picked up against Bayern Munich, while Zubimendi sustained a knock while on international duty with Spain.

Arteta confirmed on Friday that Saka would not require surgery, but the England winger is still facing around a month on the sidelines. He said via The Mirror : "Yeah, so we had another test; he's evolving really well, but it's going to be an eight-week injury, more or less. So I think he's four at the moment, so it's still a while for him to be back with the team.

"Martin [Zubimendi] is [also] out. Unfortunately, he has a muscular problem in his hamstring. He wasn't too concerned to be fair after the game, but after the MRI scan shows that there is an injury there, and he's going to be out for a few weeks, I think."

While both Saka and Zubimendi are ruled out, William Saliba looks set to return to the squad for the trip to Newcastle.

The French defender has been absent with a back problem since the FIFA World Cup, but Arteta confirmed he is ready to be selected, saying: "He's ready. He's in good condition. We want to ramp up his minutes. He played actually two games, one behind closed doors and one more official [the Under-21s], and he did really well and he's in good condition."

To listen to the latest episode of 'All Out Soccer' - CLICK HERE

Bruno Guimarães was also a topic of discussion, with the midfielder preparing to face the club he left in the summer. Arteta expects a warm reception for the Brazilian, while also confirming that international teammate Gabriel Magalhães returned in good shape following the break.

He commented: "Yeah both Gabi and him [Guimarães] came back and the same as the others and they are in good condition and we need to nail the preparation and we know how difficult it is to play against Newcastle. I hope (he gets a good reception), I think he was one of the main players, and he came in a really important part."

articles.title: Kane suffers ankle injury as Bayern held by Cologne
articles.summary: Harry Kane was subbed out early with injury as his Bayern Munich side drew 1-1 at home with lowly Cologne in the Bundesliga on Friday. Bayern also lost Micha...
articles.body:
Harry Kane was subbed out early with injury as his Bayern Munich side drew 1-1 at home with lowly Cologne in the Bundesliga on Friday.

Tottenham loanee Mikey Moore scored before Kane's injury but Bayern levelled things up when Nathaniel Brown scored before the break.

El Mala had an excellent late chance to snare a first Cologne win at Bayern since 2009 but he pulled the ball just wide with the goal beckoning.

Now a point behind Bayern, chasers Borussia Dortmund can move into outright first on the table if they win at Borussia Moenchengladbach on Saturday.

Bayern also lost Michael Olise to injury in yet another injury blow for the undermanned side.

Bayern welcomed coach Vincent Kompany back after a month-long absence and midfielder Jamal Musiala after two months out on Friday, but are already without Luis Diaz, Serge Gnabry, Alphonso Davies, Ismael Saibari and captain Manuel Neuer.

Despite the draw Bayern, who play away at Lille in the Champions League on Wednesday, remain the only undefeated side in Europe's top-five leagues in all competitions this season.

Kompany returned to the dugout with his arm in a sling, having dislocated his shoulder when he collapsed on the training pitch before being hospitalised with meningeal irritation in October.

Cologne, who arrived in Munich with just one league victory this season, took a surprise lead with 12 minutes gone when Moore started and finished an excellent counter-attack.

Moore pounced on a mislaid Olise pass and drove forward, finding Linton Maina who laid off for El Mala.

With Bayern's defence closing in, El Mala stroked a no-look backheel in Moore's path and the Spurs loanee coolly rounded goalkeeper Jonas Urbig and slid the ball home.

Bayern went on the attack immediately but suffered another setback when Kane was brought down in the Cologne box from behind by defender Joel Schmied.

Having his penalty appeals waved away, Kane rose gingerly and tried to continue, but was visibly limping and was subbed out soon after.

With Cologne sitting deep, Bayern attacked from a distance and broke through before the break when Brown sliced a low shot into the bottom right to level the scores.

The hosts suffered another blow in the dying stages of the opening half when Olise went down under a challenge.

The France winger did not return to the field after half-time and was seen leaving the stadium shortly after on crutches.

Sensing a first victory over Bayern since 2011 -- a run of 23 games including 21 defeats -- Cologne continued to push, with El Mala and Maina forcing a spectacular double save from Urbig just before the hour mark.

El Mala had a golden chance to put Cologne in front with eight minutes to go when one-on-one with Urbig but cut his close-range shot inches wide of the post.
